title: COBRA: Public Works and Contract Oversight

blocks.content: COBRA — revolutionizing the oversight of public works and contracts

A new way to monitor contracts, projects and public works: an AI-first platform where intelligent agents read evidence from the field and deliver decisions. Anytime, anywhere, with visual, real-time control.
Every stakeholder, a single source of truth

COBRA enables project and contract oversight involving every stakeholder (contractors, independent inspectors, supervisors and other parties) with real-time information that empowers senior management to make the best decisions.
A unique combination of technology, data analytics, hardware and a highly qualified team, so your projects are executed with complete clarity.
The latest technology in every component for real-time control of projects and contracts.
AI-powered visual recognition of photos and videos to identify patterns. Your organization recognizes objects in images captured by inspectors and generates large-scale data analytics.
Manage your projects in real time
We capture the real dynamics between contractors, inspectors and supervisors in an easy, intuitive interface. Top-quality information, always at hand, to help you reach your goals.
Revolutionize the oversight of your public works with COBRA
Request a demo and see how COBRA gives you full, real-time visibility into projects and contracts.
The professional, creative and innovative technology partner for public-sector transparency.
